map.单张墨量=面积×覆盖率×墨膜厚×密度=0.5×0.40×1.2×1.2=0.28: Ink per sheet = area×coverage×thickness×density = 0.5×0.40×1.2×1.2 = 0.288 g. Per thousand sheets = 288 g; net total ink = 0.288×10000 = 2880 g, with 5% waste = 3024 g = 3.024 kg, of which 144 g is waste. Switching to CMYK coverage [40,30,25,90] (black 90% solid), total four-color ink = 0.5×((0.40+0.30+0.25+0.90)/100)×1.2×1.2×10000×1.05/1000 ≈ 13.99 kg, about 4.6 times the single-color case, showing how dominant heavy black coverage is in ink consumption.
map.单张墨量公式各量纲怎么约掉？: How do the dimensions cancel in the per-sheet formula?
map.面积(m²)×覆盖率(0~1)×墨膜厚(μm，即 10⁻⁶ m)×密度(g/cm: area(m²)×coverage(0~1)×thickness(μm, i.e. 10⁻⁶ m)×density(g/cm³ = 10⁶ g/m³) → g. That is 0.5×0.4×1.2e-6×1.2e6 = 0.288 g, and the dimensions automatically resolve to grams. The identity holds exactly when thickness uses micrometers and density uses g/cm³.
map.损耗 5% 从哪来？: Where does the 5% waste come from?
map.指洗车、调墨、试印、管道残留等工艺损耗，单色常取 3%~5%，专色或浅色因清洗更: It refers to process losses from ink washing, mixing, proofing and pipe residue; single color typically uses 3%-5%, and spot or light colors can be higher because washing is more frequent. It multiplies net ink by (1+waste%) rather than being deducted from the print run.

map.💡 公式：墨量(kg) = 面积(m²) × 覆盖率 × 墨膜厚度(μm) ×: 💡 Formula: ink(kg) = area(m²) × coverage × film thickness(μm) × density(g/cm³) × print run × (1+waste rate) ÷ 1000. Note: 1 μm × 1 m² = 1 cm³ (1e4 cm² × 1e-4 cm); multiplying by g/cm³ gives grams, then ÷1000 converts to kg.
map.CMYK 各色覆盖率需填写 0–100% 的数值: CMYK per-color coverage must be a value between 0 and 100%

map.有效覆盖面积(每张) = 印刷面积 × 覆盖率；单张墨量(g) = 印刷面积(m: Effective coverage area (per sheet) = print area × coverage; ink per sheet (g) = print area (m²) × coverage × film thickness (μm) × ink density (g/cm³); ink per 1000 sheets = ink per sheet × 1000; total ink (kg) = ink per sheet × print run × (1 + waste rate) ÷ 1000 (5% when waste is checked); waste ink = total ink − net ink; total ink cost = total ink (kg) × unit price (CNY/kg), cost per sheet = total cost ÷ print run. Validation: coverage 0–100%, thickness and density above 0, print run a positive integer
